messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High 5xx rate observed on text-gen-prod across us-west-2. SLO error budget breached. Paging oncall @sasha (oncall).

sasha (oncall): on it, joining bridge. Can someone drop last 5min qps and error sample?

maria (eng-sre): grabbing logs now. throwing a quick Kibana query. possible spike from batching service -- getting stack traces.

devops-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/incident/2248005123 | runbook: /runbooks/text-gen-5xx.md

sasha (oncall): thanks. @maria, run a quick canary rollback if you see config drift?

maria (eng-sre): rolling back routing flag to v2->v1 for the last 10m. patch in progress: ```
kubectl apply -f /deploys/text-gen-routing-rollback.yaml
# rolling restart svc/text-gen
```

shaun (infra): noticed GPU pool saturation on node-pool-g4-1 in us-west-2 at the same time. throttling autoscaler events. correlating.

luis (support): fielding a ticket from a key customer (acme-corp) reporting 502s on high-volume batch inference. They reported start ~02:39 UTC.

sasha (oncall): timeline matches. Maria, any immediate change after rollback?

maria (eng-sre): errors dropped ~70% within 90s of rollback. still seeing intermittent 502s from a subset of pods. collecting pod logs: ```
ERROR 2026-09-12T02:41:12Z TextGen worker failed to allocate KV cache: OOM
trace: kv_cache_alloc -> fallback -> runtime-exception
```

shaun (infra): that OOM message aligns with a recent image change that bumped sequence buffer defaults. rolling that image back now too.

emily (product-ops): starting impact assessment. which customers hit and which routes affected? Priority: embed, chat, rerank.

luis (support): confirmed ACME and BetaLabs saw failures on "/v1/chat/complete" and batched embedding endpoint. Ticket numbers: INC-3981, INC-3984.

sasha (oncall): good. I'll mark incident as mitigated once OOM traces are gone. For RCA we need timeline, contributing factors, evidence (logs, deploy diffs), customer impact minutes, and remediation actions.

maria (eng-sre): capturing artifacts: links -> logs: https://logs.redwood/2248005123, deploy diffs: https://git.redwood/ops/text-gen/commits/abc123..def456, node metrics: https://monitor.redwood/graph?node=node-pool-g4-1

emily (product-ops): also need a short customer impact summary for comms: count of affected requests, number of unique customers, and examples of errors. luis, can you pull numbers from Zendesk/telemetry?

luis (support): on it. preliminary: ~9k failed requests over a 6m window, ~12 unique tenant IDs, 2 high-touch customers escalated. Will paste exact query and numbers to the evidence doc.

shaun (infra): adding follow-up to check autoscaler default thresholds. suspect interplay between batch size bump and pod memory limits.

sasha (oncall): scheduling post-incident follow-up. Proposed: Postmortem meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Owner: @maria (eng-sre) to draft RCA. Reviewers: @shaun (infra), @sasha (oncall), @emily (product-ops). Does that work? :calendar:

maria (eng-sre): OK I'll own the writeup. Will include timeline, root cause hypotheses, evidence links, and remediation plan. Target draft by EOD today.

emily (product-ops): please include customer-facing impact blurb (2-3 lines) so we can prep comms if needed.

olivia (legal): heads up — if ACME escalates, we may need to preserve additional logs beyond retention. Recommend we snapshot relevant S3 buckets and escalate to compliance.

maria (eng-sre): noted. I'll export logs to s3://incidents/2248005123/evidence.zip and tag for legal hold.

luis (support): uploaded screenshots and customer logs to the evidence folder. Zendesk links: https://zd.redwood/incidents/INC-3981,INC-3984

sasha (oncall): action items I'm tracking in the incident board: 1) rollback confirmed & monitor (closed), 2) pod memory defaults review (open), 3) autoscaler policy tweak (open), 4) add integration test for batch sizing (open). Please add any other tasks to the jira: RW-INC-2248.

maria (eng-sre): draft outline below for the RCA. tagging reviewers inline. Please ack or add comments.

--- RCA DRAFT OUTLINE ---
1) Summary impact (short)
2) Timeline (events with minute granularity)
3) Contributing factors (deploy change, config defaults, autoscaler behavior)
4) Evidence (logs, diffs, metrics) -> links attached
5) Customer impact (tenants, failed request counts, duration)
6) Remediation (short-term mitigations + long-term fixes)
7) Postmortem meeting notes + owners
---

shaun (infra): looks good. request we add a short investigation note about GPU scheduling preemption and pod eviction logs.

emily (product-ops): +1 add comms owner and suggested message. I'll draft a customer note once we sync on impact numbers.

olivia (legal): confirm legal hold plan and preserve request IDs mentioned by customers.

sasha (oncall): timeline requirement: please ensure the timeline lists first error at 02:39 UTC, rollback at 02:41, partial recovery at 02:42:30, final stability at 02:45.

maria (eng-sre): will include exact timestamps. uploading initial RCA draft to https://docs.redwood/rca/2248005123-draft this afternoon.

luis (support): added a small appendix with customer quotes and support response timeline.

sasha (oncall): reminder: reviewers, please leave comments in the doc by 13:00 UTC tomorrow so we can finalize before the 15:00 postmortem meeting. After meeting we aim for sign-off by eng leads and legal by EOD following day.

emily (product-ops): noted. I'll circulate calendar invite for the postmortem with the doc link and attach the customer impact blurb.

maria (eng-sre): quick note: short-term remediation planned: 1) pin default batch size to safe value, 2) increase pod memory by 20% for the affected deployment, 3) add a canary gating step on production image rollout. Long-term: autoscaler improvements and chaos tests.

shaun (infra): assigning RW-INC-2248-3 to myself (autoscaler policy tweak). ETA 2 days.

luis (support): will coordinate customer follow-ups, drafting templated replies for affected tenants.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 02:47 UTC. Severity -> Sev2. Please follow up with RCA thread: /postmortems/2248005123 when ready.

sasha (oncall): thanks team. Great coordination. Closing bridge but keeping thread open for RCA/artefacts.

maria (eng-sre): final: I pushed the initial draft at 11:18 local and left TODOs for metrics graphs. reviewers, ping me if you need raw queries.

emily (product-ops): ACK. I'll prep comms once luis confirms numbers.

olivia (legal): ACK on evidence snapshot; let me know when done so we can log the hold.

shaun (infra): one final ask — add a short bullet in the RCA about how quantization changes interact with memory and OOM risk. Seen that before.

maria (eng-sre): good call; adding it. Closing notes: draft ready for review at https://docs.redwood/rca/2248005123-draft — reviewers please leave comments by 13:00 UTC.

luis (support): thanks all. I'll post final customer follow-up templates after the meeting. :tada:
